class.name: JRPGAudioCue
class.brief_description: A sound or music reference used by JRPG data.
class.description: Points to an audio file by path and stores how to play it: volume, pitch and pan. The audio is loaded only when the cue is played, so database data never holds audio streams.

method.name: is_empty
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if no audio file is set.

members.member: Playback speed in percent, from 50 to 150.
Path ([code]uid://[/code] or [code]res://[/code]) of the audio file.
